implementation: ACompanionActor caches the mesh and role signal light base transforms, then adds CompanionIdleFollowHoldPose and CompanionGestureReadabilityRuntime tags.
playability_result: Rescue teammates read as present, alert, and formation-aware instead of only moving capsules with HUD labels.

implementation: The companion constructor creates CompanionRoleSignalLight, and ConfigureSquadPersonality refreshes it from RoleAccentColor.
playability_result: Mira, Tomas, Ada, Noor, and Briggs keep a compact role-colored in-world identity cue that matches HUD pips and order barks.

implementation: TryFireAtNearbyZombie calls TriggerSupportFireGesture after a valid support shot.
playability_result: Players can see a short recoil/role-light pulse when a companion contributes combat pressure.

implementation: Automatic and manual medic pulses call TriggerMedicPulseGesture after healing the player.
playability_result: The medic support moment reads as a visible lift and light pulse, not only a health number change.

implementation: Regroup, hold, follow, and role-order bark paths call TriggerOrderGesture.
playability_result: Y/U/O/N squad commands produce a visible acknowledgment cue that matches subtitles and HUD order state.

implementation: TakeCompanionDamage calls TriggerDamageGesture before death handling.
playability_result: Companions visibly react to damage without changing capsule collision, movement behavior, or save state.
